rationale: Pulp's import-design CLI now classifies ordinary runnable HTML as its own source instead of pretending every browser-evaluated document is a Claude Design export. The transferred anchor-strategy switch gains the corresponding DesignSource::html case so generic HTML receives the same stable content-hash anchoring as other runtime-evaluated document sources. This is Pulp-specific importer provenance and compatibility plumbing: it does not change the transferred design schema, code-generation contract, or Vellum source authority.
